name: mana-station
description: Mana Station: pays Mana only for allowlisted calls into approved apps (TESTNET prototype)

scripts.build: koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 0 station.proto --generate_authorize && node scripts/make-abi.cjs
scripts.build:sim: node scripts/prebuild.cjs && koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 1 station.proto --generate_authorize
scripts.test: npm run build:sim && node node_modules/@as-pect/cli/bin/asp.js --config as-pect.config.js
